newsitem.title: FRANCE: RUGBY UNION-AUCAGNE TAKES OVER FROM INJURED PENAUD.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-AUCAGNE TAKES OVER FROM INJURED PENAUD.

text.p: France changed their half-backs and one prop on Wednesday for the Five Nations' championship grand slam decider against Scotland at Parc des Princes on Saturday.

Pau fly-half David Aucagne takes over from the injured Alain Penaud, while Guy Accoceberry replaces Penaud's Brive team mate Philippe Carbonneau at scrum-half in the side announced by coach Jean-Claude Skrela.
Brive prop Didier Casadei wins his first cap in place of the suspended Christian Califano.

France - 15-Jean-Luc Sadourny; 14-Laurent Leflamand, 13-Christophe Lamaison, 12-Stephane Glas, 11-David Venditti; 10-David Aucagne, 9-Guy Accoceberry; 8-Fabien Pelous, 7-Olivier Magne, 6-Abdelatif Benazzi (captain), 5-Hugues Miorin, 4-Olivier Merle, 3-Franck Tournaire, 2-Marc Dal Maso, 1-Didier Casadei.
